items.text: Can't say enough about this family owned company. I've moved multiple times and was always charged more than the quoted price. Well, Mike Hammer came and gave me an in-home estimate which ended up being exactly what he quoted. These people are honest and value their employees. Best moving company in Kansas City!

Mike Hammer was prompt on time, professional affordable and overall a great company for our move. They were very flexible and actually ended up coming in under estimate! The crew worked very hard and really appreciate the help. This was my first time using a mover and I'm glad it was Mike Hammer's group.

Cameron, Manny, and Brett did an excellent job in the rain. I had a multi-stop move, across state lines, and it included moving a pretty heavy upright piano. They were on time, careful with each of the items, and provided excellent service. And, I don't think any movers in the KC metro could beat the price.

I have recently used Mike Hammer Moving for a large 5-bedroom home move, in addition to unpacking services, and trash haul away. Their service is impeccable. The movers were all very knowledgeable, professional, and courteous. They turned my extremely stressful move into a seamless transition into my new home…

blocks.heading: No move too big or too small.
blocks.text: Full-time crews, upfront pricing, and a truck in Lenexa ready to go.
